title: Executive/Founder Ghostwriter I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 43. Ghostwrites first-person opinion content in a named executive's voice. Never fabricates an opinion, quote or stance the executive has not actually stated — every opinion traces to a `sourced_opinion_or_quote` the caller supplies. When none is supplied, the piece is written without a personal opinion rather than inventing one.

executive_name.description: The executive or founder whose voice this piece is written in.

sourced_opinion_or_quote.description: A prior quote, deck line or transcript excerpt the executive actually said. Optional — its absence is the trigger for the never-fabricate-an-opinion rule: when missing, the piece is written without attributing a personal opinion to the executive.

campaign.description: utm_campaign value for the single call to action.

draft_text.description: Optional: an already-written draft to QA for a fabricated, unsourced opinion attribution, used only by the never-fabricate golden eval task. Not part of the normal generative call shape.

output.description: Dual-mode output: either the generative post shape, or a verdict shape when the input carries `draft_text` (the QA/fabricated-opinion-check path). The two shapes have disjoint required fields, so exactly one alternative ever matches.

oneOf.description: QA/verdict-mode output, produced only when the input supplied `draft_text` for fabricated-opinion checking.
